claim: A physical correspondence between two ordered language roles must distinguish the intended assignment from exchanging the two endpoint identities. Can this distinction change actual subject identity and supervise a continuous geometric consensus at the selected subject?
scope: Fixed simplified v1, source models, no new training, no output or reference labels as inference inputs, no FINAL. Use the original caption and retain its four physical subject proposals and exact score marginal. An existing parser supplies the factual two-end clause B and the converse clause D with both entity phrases exchanged and the left/right predicate inverted. Both are evidence requests; neither gets a new training label.
evidence: Factual B reads original v1 subject boxes and its own reference boxes; use B conditional reference probabilities given a subject. D supplies its own frozen joint four by four physical boxes in reversed role order. Per-pair correspondence is the intersection volume divided by geometric mean volume. For a four-box tuple the signed evidence is k(s,s')k(r,r') - k(s,r')k(r,s'). Separate its positive and negative parts. From original subject mass times factual conditional and reverse joint mass, assign stay weight 1-negative_part and exchange-aligned shape weight positive_part. Choose the subject with largest resulting total mass. Estimate its geometry from all these weights by a Euclidean barycenter of centers, log-height and symmetric squared horizontal side-length tensors. Same zero evidence restores the starting boxes and scores. Report where reciprocal geometry creates new hits, including when every original A256 falls short.
controls: subject_overlap sees only subject physical agreement. positive_product uses same two matched roles without the opposite order. independent_roles removes statistical dependence between the two ends in both B and D while keeping their marginals. wrong_reference cyclically reassigns the D reference boxes to different column indices after reversing roles (same geometry and score multisets). ordered_raw reports the actual new subject identity with original geometry; ordered_frozen_subject forces the v1 winner with ordered geometry. Every arm consumes the same fitted weights and stored queries. No setting selected from targets.

source_proxy.description: Existing 50 Waymo, 15 Drone, 46 Quad natural expressions with a singular reference uniquely matched by the historical source inventory/attachment rule. Evaluate each with all three fixed models. Separate the 111 source-own from the 222 cross-platform records. The selection and reference identities use a retrospective annotation proxy; they are not a representative target split or fresh human judgments.

evaluation: Seal all predictions before scoring. Strict seven-dimensional official-label Acc25/50 and mIoU, per source->target and six-direction macro, all fallbacks. To distinguish identity use the original raw box from the chosen subject, before any shape fusion. Call an identity resolved if it overlaps exactly one inventory object above 0.25, mark ambiguous or uncovered UNKNOWN. Count correct-to-wrong, wrong-to-correct, and all transitions to/from UNKNOWN separately. Geometry primary is paired Acc50 on unambiguously correct original subject rows with the same chosen identity before and after. Count raw failures and novel continuous rescues when all original A256 are below 0.50 and separately when both compared query pools also fail. Compare endpoint occupancy against inventory-proxy reference when available. Ordinary 170/171 reference IDs are UNKNOWN unless traceable to an independent certificate. All revealed subsets are descriptive. Results conditional on already exposed relation panels.
decision: To advance require physical subject corrections above definite harms compared with original and same-information controls, geometry net rescue on same verified-by-inventory subject before and after, and actual beyond-original-A256 hits. Show results separately on the natural recording panels and proxy-selected panels. Failure at either link precludes adopting or claiming a verified novel solution.
